script.es: 35 años cuidando el cabello de Tallahassee.

parrafo.es: Private Quarters Hair Salon atiende el vecindario de Frenchtown en Tallahassee desde hace más de 35 años. Brenda Moss y su equipo trabajan silk press, relaxer, locs, weaves, cornrows, box plats y color con la misma dedicación de siempre.
parrafo.en: Private Quarters Hair Salon has served Tallahassee's Frenchtown neighborhood for over 35 years. Brenda Moss and her team work silk press, relaxer, locs, weaves, cornrows, box plats and color with the same care they always have.

hero.imagen_alt: Finished copper and caramel highlight result at Private Quarters Hair Salon, Tallahassee

parrafo_1.es: Brenda Moss, conocida por sus clientas como "Queen B", abrió Private Quarters Hair Salon en el vecindario de Frenchtown, en Tallahassee, con la idea de un salón amplio pero íntimo. Más de 35 años después, sigue siendo maestra estilista e instructora, y la mayoría de sus clientas la acompañan desde hace más de 20 años.
parrafo_1.en: Brenda Moss, known to her clients as "Queen B", opened Private Quarters Hair Salon in Tallahassee's Frenchtown neighborhood around the idea of a spacious yet intimate salon. More than 35 years later, she is still a master stylist and instructor, and most of her clients have been with her for 20 years or more.

parrafo_2.es: El equipo, con Ashley Moss, Chris, Shay y Sumayah, trabaja silk press, relaxer, locs, weaves, cornrows, box plats y color. El salón fue reconocido por Florida A&M University como Emerging Business of the Year y Outstanding Business of the Year.
parrafo_2.en: The team, with Ashley Moss, Chris, Shay and Sumayah, works silk press, relaxer, locs, weaves, cornrows, box plats and color. The salon has been recognized by Florida A&M University as Emerging Business of the Year and Outstanding Business of the Year.

items.quote: I've gotten my hair done here about 4-5 times now and this time I decided to just cut it off. Mrs. Brenda is awesome, patient, informative, and funny. She gave me exactly what I wanted and I love it. I really enjoy the atmosphere, it just reminds me of going to the salon in the 90's. Book, book, book! There are other great stylists here as well.
